generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
EMD Payments through KPPP Portal mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP Portal.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt. orders.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents KW-4 K.P.W.D. and further orders there on.

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work
Contractor should establish a fully functional laboratory at site at no extra cost in order to carry out all the required tests for the materials being used in the project

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing canal CD works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.
Contractor should carryout additional test required to test the suitability of materials including borrow area before using the same either as sub-grade or base course materials.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.
Formation levels and other data furnished are bare minimum. the contractor should make all efforts to validate and to get additional data if required at his own cost.
Contractor should execute the project with least impact to the environment especially during earthwork, laying of GSB, bituminous surface etc.

Contractor should adhere to HSE policy applicable for similar projects. Contractor to that extent should submit HSE document defining all the procedure including the policies before execution of the project
Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD, Division, Tumkur during office hours on all working days.

Materials like bitumen, steel, cement etc., required for the work shell be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work at their own cost.
The contractors assessed available tender capacity will be calculated as per the clause 3.6 of STD tender document Attached.

All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works, cost and conyence of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer - in - charge of this work.

When embankments are constructed disputes arising on account of damages to the existing field / channels, bunds and other private properties, if any, has to be resolved by the contractor. All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public private properties
Contractor should take all precautionary measures to avoid any damage to the utilities during excavation as well as utility shifting. To that extent the contractor should indemnify the client.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act.

The tenderer who quotes amount less than amount put to tender should pay difference amount in the form of FDR purchased through any nationalized / scheduled bank payable in favor The Executive Engineer at the time of execution of the tender agreement
Note:- If any postponement of receipt date of tender, the same will be published in the KPPP protal portal.
The contractor shall maintain the road periodically, including removal of jungle, shoulder,drains and cross drain works asper the site conditions &as per the directions of Engineer in charge of work.

All the originals of uploaded documents in KPP-portal should be produced within 7 working days from the date of opening of Technical Bid at the Division Office, failing which the tender is liable for rejection. No separate communication will be made in this regard, failing which action will be taken as per tender conditions and registration rules
The returns submitted to the I.T. along with the Profit and Loss account statement,Balance sheet should be uploaded for the financial turnover criteria attested by registered Chartered Accountant.

Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act. Contractors are directed to employ only the labours who are registered in Labour Department, if the labours are not registered, they are to be registered before employing them to the work.

Contractors participating in the bid should submit Original Line of Credit of the copy uploaded through KPPP Portal with in one week after the last date of receipt of tenders. failing which their technical bids will be rejected.
Contractors should be registered with KPWD Class III and above Registration.

Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.5 of ITT and Clause 44 of the Conditions of Contract. :
The defect liability period for this project is 1 Year.
AS PER THE GOVT ORDER NO: FD417EXP-12/2024 DATED 09-08-2024 GST WILL BE PAID SEPARATELY

The quantities for the necessary deviation road and cofferdam are provided on a one time basis in the BOQ and any additional quantities required for completion of the work shall be deemed included in the Contractor rates no extra payment shall be admissible and such works shall be executed at the Contractor own cost and risk
